name: Build the bridge's C API into lantern-native
body: lantern-native compiles penumbra-bridge's `capi/src` beside Nyx's C API and the Chaos UI bridge, so the editor host loads one copy of Nyx. `engine/native/CMakeLists.txt` takes the bridge from `LANTERN_PENUMBRA_BRIDGE_SOURCE_DIR` (default a `penumbra-bridge` checkout beside lantern; `build-native.sh` passes `PENUMBRA_BRIDGE_SOURCE_DIR`), and the `.map` and `.exports` files export its `penumbra_bridge_` functions. The host's `tools/setup.sh` copies the bridge's Nox sources with their foreign block pointed at lantern-native instead of `penumbra-bridge-capi`.
